# tebibcloud_certificate (Resource)

A TLS certificate for HTTPS listeners on load balancers. **Managed**: give `domain_names` and `validation`; TebibCloud orders a free certificate from Let's Encrypt and renews it. **Imported**: give `certificate`, `certificate_chain` and `private_key`; the key is sealed on this machine to the platform's public key before it is sent, so the API can't read it. Caveat: `private_key` is stored in the Terraform state (marked sensitive) and never read back; protect the state. Attach the certificate to an `https` `tebibcloud_load_balancer_listener`. A certificate a listener uses can't be deleted.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `certificate` (String) Imported: the leaf certificate (PEM).
- `certificate_chain` (String) Imported: the intermediate certificates (PEM).
- `description` (String) Description, at most 255 characters. Default: empty.
- `domain_names` (List of String) Managed: up to 5 names (`*.example.com` needs `validation = "dns"`). Imported: filled from the certificate. Changing it replaces the certificate.
- `name` (String) Name, unique among the project's certificates. Default: made from the first domain. Changing it replaces the certificate.
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) Imported: the private key (PEM, unencrypted, RSA 2048-4096 or ECDSA P-256/P-384). Sealed before it is sent; kept in state, never read back.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID (`p-...`). Default: the provider's `project`. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags (key-value pairs). IAM policies can match them. Default: none.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `validation` (String) Managed: `dns` (names in a zone hosted with TebibCloud) or `http` (names that point at one of the project's public load balancers, which needs an http listener on port 80).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339).
- `fingerprint` (String) SHA-256 fingerprint of the leaf certificate.
- `id` (String) Certificate ID (`cert-...`).
- `issuer` (String) Issuing CA.
- `not_after` (String) End of validity (RFC 3339).
- `not_before` (String) Start of validity (RFC 3339).
- `renew_after` (String) Managed: when renewal starts (a third of the lifetime before the end).
- `source` (String) `managed` or `imported`.
- `state` (String) Lifecycle state: `active` once ready (or `error`).
- `status` (String) `pending`, `issued`, `failed` or `revoked`.
- `status_code` (String) Why it isn't issued (for example `dns_not_pointing`, `caa_blocks`, `key_mismatch`).
- `status_message` (String) What the platform last said about the resource.
- `status_reason` (String) The reason in words.
- `test_certificate` (Boolean) True when issued by a test CA that browsers don't trust (staging).
- `trn` (String) TebibCloud resource name (TRN), for IAM policies.

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
